memory_scope: Largest categorical array only, NOT process peak memory; state/action/index arrays and runtime also exist.
scope: Ordinary cheaper one-goal feasibility baseline, NOT adaptive-policy near-optimality. The SAME exact chosen table was independently obtained from the cheap retained discovery counts; its equality was checked before using this evaluation stream. Counts for other blocks can also be retained, not discarded.

proposal.scope: Uncertified proposal from the same retained discovery data. Its exact policy is checked against the selected tagged policy before sharing any evaluation outcomes.
